sentences.en: I kept him company while his wife was in surgery.
sentences.zh: 我陪着他，他妻子正在做手术。

sentences.en: Plastic surgery alone will not make you any less ugly.
sentences.zh: 光靠整容手术并不能让你变得不那么丑。

sentences.en: A side effect of the eye surgery is dry eyes.
sentences.zh: 眼科手术的一个副作用就是眼睛干涩。

senses.zh: 外科学，外科手术,手术室,诊所,诊断时间
